RPSC Sub Inspector 2021 Exam City / Admit Card Date 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has released the re exam admit card date for the post of Sub Inspector / Platoon Commander. This recruitment was issued for 859 posts. The Exam is scheduled to be conducted on 20 September 2026. Online applying process for Rajasthan RPSC RPSC SI / Platoon Commander Recruitment 2021 were accepted from 09 February 2021 to 23 June 2021. Candidates who had applied this form can check their RPSC SI / Platoon Commander Re Exam Admit Card Date 2026 which has given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 09 February 2021
  • Last Date : 23 June 2021
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 23 June 2021
  • Exam Date: 13, 15 September 2021
  • Admit Card : 07 September 2021
  • Answer Key : 11 October 2021
  • Result : 24 December 2021
  • PET Exam Date : 12-18 February 2022
  • PET Admit Card : 24 January 2022
  • PET Result : 11 April 2022
  • Interview Date : 23 January 2023 to 02 February 2023
  • Final Result : 01 June 2023
  • Re Exam Date : 20 September 2026
  • Re Exam City Details : 13 September 2026
  • Re Admit Card : 17 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General / Other State : Rs. 350/-
  • OBC / BC : Rs. 250/-
  • SC / ST : Rs. 150/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
